Die originalen Regeln des Spiels: The original rules of the game
Bewege alle 4 deiner Figuren vom Start i: Move all 4 of your pieces from start to goal. The first player to get all pieces to the goal wins.
Eine Figur darf nur aus dem Haus auf das: A piece may only leave home when you roll a 6. Rolling a 6 also grants an extra roll.
Du bewegst eine deiner Figuren um die ge: Move one of your pieces forward by the number rolled. You choose which piece to move.
Landet deine Figur auf einem Feld, das v: If your piece lands on a square occupied by an opponent's piece, it is captured and sent back home.
Die farbigen Startfelder sind geschützt: The colored start squares are protected — pieces cannot be captured there.
Figuren laufen im Uhrzeigersinn und bieg: Pieces move clockwise and turn into the colored home stretch. You need the exact number to enter the goal.
Du musst ziehen, wenn es möglich ist. Ha: You must move if possible. If you have no piece on the board and don't roll a 6, you skip your turn.
Wer eine 6 würfelt, darf nach dem Zug no: Rolling a 6 grants another roll after moving — as many times as 6 keeps coming up.
Wer dreimal hintereinander eine 6 würfel: Rolling three 6s in a row forfeits your turn and sends your last piece back home.
